description: Branching tree (factor=3). Each node: { value, children[] }. Stresses recursive traversal.

parameters.key_overhead: "value" + "children" key names + braces at every node

notes: Uses branching > 1 (not a single-child chain) so overhead comes from tree structure, not just depth. Each level contributes similar value size. JSON adds braces + key names at every branch.
